snapshot.text: Free public health care for citizens, with expatriates paying fees and insurance. The ministry has cut medicine prices and tightened governance rules and expat medical checks.

priorities.title: Cheaper medicines
priorities.text: Kuwait cut the prices of 1,922 medicines, making them the cheapest in the Gulf.

priorities.title: Governance and security rules
priorities.text: The health minister issued rules to strengthen governance and security in the health sector.

priorities.title: Expat medical checks
priorities.text: Medical checks for expatriates were tightened under the revised Wafed framework.
